summary: Tested iteration 40 features: IBKR forex status, MR strategies (mr_zscore, mr_keltner_fade), forex commissions in settings, copilot background chat job, optimizer queue series and forex backtest. All 6 backend regression tests PASS. Frontend: Optimizer modal opens with 'Zur Warteschlange' button (opt-add-series testid) confirmed via screenshot. Tools menu → Strategie-Optimizer works. Note: some preview-network flakiness (occasional 502/timeouts).

minor.issue: Occasional preview-ingress ConnectTimeout during long polling (10s timeouts). Not a code bug; test re-runs pass consistently.

integration_issues.flow: Admin login persistence for Master-Einstellungen panel via browser automation

Manual testing likely works; testids control-forex-fees-card / fee-forex-comm-input / fee-forex-min-input / ibkr-status all confirmed present in /app/frontend/src/components/SettingsPanel.js.

Strategy <select> was empty when the Optimizer modal opened during test run (no options rendered). Likely transient /api/strategies fetch failure in preview session (many 'Failed to fetch' console errors from the frontend during automation). Backend /api/strategies correctly returns mr_zscore and mr_keltner_fade.

action_items: Frontend selectors are consistent with request; main agent can manually verify Master-Einstellungen → 'Kontrolle' tab shows the Forex-Gebühren card + IBKR status line after admin login.

Optimizer strategy dropdown appeared empty during automation; verify strategies list loads reliably in Optimizer modal (may be due to auth token headers not attached on /api/strategies fetch in that view).
Preview backend intermittently 502s and returns HTML pages that cause frontend 'Unexpected token <' JSON parse errors – consider surfacing a user-friendly retry state.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/job_series.py series/add expects {kind, body:<payload>} (nested). Frontend integrations must send the payload under 'body' key; original problem statement's example ('body: <optimizer body>') matches the code but is easy to get wrong – consider accepting flat body as fallback for DX.
Optimizer modal fetches /api/strategies without a visible loading placeholder for the strategy <select> – dropdown appears empty on fetch failure, which is confusing.
Copilot chat background job endpoint (/api/copilot/chat/start + /chat/job/{id}) works and successfully bypasses the Render 60s timeout as claimed.
Forex fee updates via /api/settings correctly persist and are decoupled from crypto fees – confirmed via GET after POST.
